True love, to me, requires tremendous strength. You have to be able to see and endure suffering by those that you love, knowing that they will be improved as individuals by that suffering. Knowing this, you can begin to see the real power of speaking the truth to people you love.

Life is not all good times and green lawns. We have to embrace our moonless nights as the gift that they are and never forget that we can be strong because we have to be strong.
